title: Repair WebView static CI contracts
summary: Repairs WebView CI contracts, exposes CPU encode mutex waiting in Settings, and keeps compact operator status privacy-safe.
reason: The PR WebView/static test cluster contained stale expectations and omitted UI wiring that prevented its browser and contract checks from passing.
behavior_before: The WebView omitted the CPU mutex wait setting, used undeclared CSS values, accepted stale browser-test expectations, and could display raw media names in compact topbar activity.
behavior_after: Settings renders and explains CPU mutex waiting, CSS and accessibility contracts are explicit, browser tests follow backend-authored evidence, and compact topbar activity omits raw media names.
manual_validation: git diff --check scoped files - passed (no whitespace errors)
python -m unittest targeted WebView contracts/browser suite - passed (119 tests)
rollback_plan: Revert the listed WebView asset, inventory, and test changes together; this does not alter backend media, publish, or settings persistence policy.
notes:
